title: telemetry
description: Daemon -> client, every ~50 Hz tick. state/currents are lerobot dicts. The periodic block (loop_hz..status) appears every TELEMETRY_INTERVAL ticks.

currents.description: Signed raw Present_Current per motor (virtual-tactile / haptics).

latch_reason.description: Why motion is blocked, as "<kind>:<detail>": "estop:<trip reason>" (operator command / face button), "overtemp:<motor>" (a joint's servo case temp crossed NORI_OVERTEMP_C), "overcurrent:<motor>" (a joint drew excess current too long — I²t-style trip, latched until reset), or "stall:<motor>" (first obstruction-stalled joint). Precedence estop > overtemp > overcurrent > stall. Absent when none is latched. The bare forms carry no detail and exist for older daemons; "obstruction" is legacy and no longer emitted.
